seo.whatIsSlugP1: A URL slug is the part of a web address that comes after the domain name and identifies a specific page in a human-readable way.
seo.whatIsSlugP2: Good slugs are short, descriptive, and use hyphens to separate words. They help both search engines and users understand what a page is about before clicking.
seo.seoFriendlyDesc: Clean slugs improve your search engine rankings by including relevant keywords in the URL.
seo.consistencyDesc: Automatically handle special characters, accents, and formatting so every URL follows the same pattern.
seo.saveTimeDesc: No more manually converting titles to URL-safe strings. Paste your text and get a slug instantly.
seo.avoidBrokenDesc: Special characters in URLs can cause 404 errors. A slug generator strips them automatically.
seo.howToCreate: How to Create a Good URL Slug
seo.howToStep1: Start with your page title or a descriptive phrase
seo.howToStep3: Replace spaces and special characters with hyphens
seo.howToStep4: Remove stop words if the slug is too long (a, the, is, etc.)
seo.howToStep5: Keep it under 60 characters for best SEO results
seo.howToStep6: Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens — no underscores or special characters
seo.featuresIntro: This free online slug generator offers:
seo.feature1Desc: See your slug update as you type
seo.feature2Desc: Choose between hyphens, underscores, or dots
seo.feature3Desc: Automatically converts accented characters to their ASCII equivalents
seo.feature4Desc: Set a character limit and the tool cuts at the nearest word boundary
seo.feature5Desc: Copy your slug to clipboard instantly
seo.useCase1: Blog post URLs for WordPress, Ghost, or Hugo
seo.useCase2: Product page URLs for e-commerce platforms
seo.faqQ1: What characters are allowed in a URL slug?
seo.faqA1: URL slugs should only contain lowercase letters (a-z), numbers (0-9), and hyphens (-). All other characters should be converted or removed.
seo.faqQ2: Should I use hyphens or underscores in slugs?
seo.faqA2: Google recommends hyphens (-) over underscores (_). Hyphens are treated as word separators by search engines, while underscores are not.
seo.faqQ3: How long should a URL slug be?
seo.faqA3: Keep your slugs under 60 characters. Shorter slugs are easier to read, share, and remember.
